name: L14 · 一个人过年多没意思啊
titleCn: 一个人过年多没意思啊
titleEn: It's boring to celebrate the Spring Festival alone

intro.cn: 在回家路上，李文和王一飞边走边聊。
intro.en: On their way home, Li Wen and Wang Yifei were walking and chatting.

questions.q: 李文看见哪儿有一个人？

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 王老师，你家楼下站着一个人。
lines.en: Ms. Wang, there's someone standing downstairs at your building.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 我家楼下？我看看。
lines.en: Downstairs at my building? Let me take a look.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 那个人穿着黑色的裤子，手里还拿着一个黑色的包。
lines.en: That person is wearing black pants and holding a black bag.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 我看见那个人了，他是我的男朋友。
lines.en: I see him. He is my boyfriend.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 那我们快过去吧。
lines.en: Let's go over quickly then.

intro.cn: 在楼下，王一飞见到杨同乐。
intro.en: Downstairs, Wang Yifei met Yang Tongle.

questions.q: 杨同乐为什么来找王一飞？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 同乐，真是你啊！上次打电话，你说有时间过来看我，没想到这么快就来了！
lines.en: Tongle, it really is you! Last time we talked on the phone, you said you'd visit me when you had time. I didn't expect you to come so soon!

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 就要过年了，你一个人在这儿多没意思啊，所以我就早早过来了。
lines.en: The Spring Festival is almost here. It's no fun for you to be here all alone, so I came here as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 你能来，我太高兴了！
lines.en: I'm so happy you could come!

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 一飞，你旁边这位是？
lines.en: Yifei, who's this next to you?

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 同乐，这是李文，他在我们学校学医。李文，这是我男朋友杨同乐。
lines.en: Tongle, this is Li Wen. He's studying medicine at our school. Li Wen, this is my boyfriend, Yang Tongle.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 李文，很高兴认识你！
lines.en: Li Wen, nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 认识你我也很高兴！我家就在前面那个楼，有时间来玩。
lines.en: Nice to meet you too! My home is just in that building up ahead. Feel free to come over when you have time.

postQuestions.q: 杨同乐来了，王一飞高兴吗？
王一飞是怎么给他们介绍的？

words.en: used in deferential reference to people

intro.cn: 在王一飞家里，王一飞和杨同乐在客厅聊天儿。
intro.en: At Wang Yifei's home, Wang Yifei and Yang Tongle were chatting in the living room.

questions.q: 王一飞教楼下的小孩儿做什么？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 一飞，你住的房子真不错，很大，离学校也不远。
lines.en: Yifei, your house is really nice, very big, and not far from school.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 是啊！我楼下还住着一家中国人，他们人很好。
lines.en: Yes! There's a Chinese family living downstairs, and they are very nice.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 这样你有事情就可以找他们帮忙。
lines.en: Then you can ask them for help if you ever need anything.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 对，我也帮他们家的小孩儿学中文。
lines.en: Yes, I also help their child learn Chinese.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 我记得你跟我说过，是个女孩儿，学得也很好。
lines.en: I remember you told me that child was a girl, and she learned so well.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 没错，她经常跑上来找我玩。
lines.en: Exactly, she often comes upstairs to play with me.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 你问问他们什么时候有时间，我请他们吃个饭。
lines.en: You can ask them when they're free, and I'll treat them to a meal.

postQuestions.q: 王一飞家楼下住着什么人？
杨同乐要请楼下的人做什么？

title.en: Writing a diary in the room

intro.cn: 在房间，王一飞在写日记。
intro.en: In the room, Wang Yifei was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 判断正误：王一飞很喜欢唱歌跳舞。
判断正误：王一飞认识杨同乐的姐姐。

lines.cn: 我男朋友姓杨，叫杨同乐。他高个子、大眼睛，唱歌唱得很好，跳舞跳得也不错。
lines.en: My boyfriend's last name is Yang, and his full name is Yang Tongle. He is tall, has big eyes, sings very well, and is also good at dancing.

lines.cn: 他和我姐姐一起工作，是姐姐介绍我们认识的。
lines.en: He and my cousin work together, and it was my cousin who introduced us.

lines.cn: 他告诉我，从见到我的第一天开始，他就喜欢上我了。
lines.en: He told me that he liked me from the very first day he met me.

grammar.note: 动态助词“着”用在动词后面可以构成存现句，动词前面是表示处所的短语，后面一般是不确指的人或事物。基本结构：处所＋动词＋着＋人/事物。
grammar.noteEn: The aspect particle “着” is placed after a verb to form an existential sentence. The phrase before the verb usually indicates a location, and the phrase after the verb generally refers to unspecified people or things. Basic structure: Location + Verb + 着 + People/Things.

items.en: Someone is standing downstairs at your building.

items.c: 爸爸手里拿着一杯咖啡。
items.en: Dad is holding a cup of coffee.

items.c: 那间教室里坐着不少学生。
items.en: Quite a few students are sitting in that classroom.

practice.cn: A：楼下____，他说他是来找你的。 B：好，我下去看看。
A：本子上面写着什么？ B：____
A：天中，你的椅子上____，你认识他吗？ B：不认识，我们过去问问他。

grammar.note: “多”用在感叹句中，表示程度很高。
grammar.noteEn: “多” is used in exclamatory sentences to express a high degree.

items.c: 你一个人在这儿多没意思啊！
items.en: It's so boring for you to be here all alone!
How nice it would be if we went together!
How pretty! Let's buy this one.

practice.cn: A：你这本书____啊！ B：是很新，可能没人爱看吧。
A：你看，孩子们____啊！ B：是啊，他们最喜欢在外边玩了。
A：别买了，这块手表____！ B：没关系，你喜欢就买。

grammar.note: “上、下、进、出、回、过”加上“来/去”，以及“起来”，用在动词后，可以构成复合趋向补语，表示动作的方向。当动词带宾语时：宾语是地点名词，放在“来/去”前面；宾语是事物名词，放在“来/去”前后都可以。
grammar.noteEn: Verbs “上”, “下”, “进”, “出”, “回”, and “过”, combined with “来”, “去”, and “起来”, are used after a verb to form compound complements of direction, indicating the direction of an action. When the verb takes an object: a location noun is placed before “来/去”; a thing noun can be placed either before or after “来/去”.

items.en: She often runs upstairs to play with me.
The building isn't tall; let's walk up.

items.c: 一听到老师叫他的名字，他就站起来了。
items.en: As soon as he heard the teacher call his name, he stood up.

items.c: 同学们都走出教室去了。
items.en: All the students walked out of the classroom.

items.c: 妈妈让我买回一些菜来。
items.en: Mom asked me to buy some vegetables and bring them back.

items.c: 白家月从书包里找出来一个漂亮的本子。
items.en: Bai Jiayue found a beautiful notebook in her schoolbag.

practice.cn: A：小雪呢？她不去商场吗？ B：她早都____了，在楼下等我们呢。
A：包里是什么东西，快____吧。 B：就是些吃的、喝的，还能有什么？
A：家月病了，我买了点儿药，现在给她____。 B：你等我一下，我跟你一起过去。

tips.note: “喜欢上”表示开始喜欢，并一直喜欢下去。
tips.noteEn: “喜欢上” means to start liking something and continue to like it.

items.cn: 他儿子的____大大的，很漂亮。
他已经几年没回国了，今年想回国____。
我从小就跟老师学____，学了十多年了。
A：请你介绍一下自己。 B：我____李，叫李明，是从上海来的。
A：您好！请问，就您一____吗？ B：还有个朋友，他一来我们就点菜。

classroomActivity.description: 两人一组，模拟帮朋友看房子的场景，互相说明房子的优点、缺点，等等。尽可能使用本课所学生词和语法。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in pairs. Role-play a scenario where you help a friend look at a house, and explain its advantages and disadvantages, and so on. Try to use the vocabulary and grammar learned in this lesson as much as possible.
